notes.title: Fake Racing has been released!
notes.content:
Finally, Fake Racing has been released on Steam.

Have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39257422/0d1eefb9b474ea1729c9afa4cba1aebec67e5605.png[/img]

notes.title: Achievements
notes.content:
A set of achievements has been added to the game. 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1481600/achievements][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39257422/64d1871f6bb822ada1225d1f613be4df71d16203.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Attack from the air
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39257422/b5dffa745e2ea7627ccaae6fefe2306aad3788ea.png[/img]

New game mode has been added - Attack from the air. Compete not only against your opponents, but also against the enemy helicopter. 

Other changes: 
[list]
[*] added difficulty level adjustment;
[*] added spatial sound.
[/list]

notes.title: Elimination!
Mirrored Tracks & Updated Palettes
notes.content:
Update:
[list]
[*] A "Mirrored Track" option has been added, which effectively doubles the number of tracks;
[*] Color palettes have been changed for a more authentic look.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39257422/3d8c92f45cc89dc253be2c2c8af72f23dee013cc.png[/img]

notes.title: VR Interface Update
notes.content:
Changes in VR mode:
- Menu is now controlled by a hand with a pointer; 
- Added a warning about motion sickness;
- Headset calibration now occurs only once before the first race. 

Other changes:
- Fixed left gamepad trigger accidentally assigned to pause. 
- Updated the game controller database. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39257422/0817440be9ad10cc75b8682364e858a5f83d0baa.png[/img]

notes.title: New tournament and 4th track
notes.content: A fourth track was added, as well as a new tournament to unlock it.

notes.title: German, French and Spanish localizations
notes.content: Added German, French and Spanish localizations.

notes.title: Fake Racing is here!
notes.content: Fake Racing has been released in Early Access. Both Desktop and VR modes are supported.

notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.content:
Fake Racing Demo has been updated:
[list]
[*]In VR mode, the pitch and roll angles were detached from the car to reduce motion sickness;
[*]Bug fixes.
[/list]
